# 創造：永不損壞的獄髓三合一工具
永不損壞的獄髓三合一工具由三種永不損壞的工具組合而成：

永不損壞的獄髓**斧頭** - [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/unbreakable-netherite-axe) [Curseforge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/create-unbreakable-netherite-axe)

永不損壞的獄髓**鎬子** - [Modrinth](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/create-unbreakable-pickaxe) [Curseforge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/create-unbreakable-pickaxe)

永不損壞的獄髓**鏟子** - [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-unbreakable-netherite-shovel) [Curseforge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/create-unbreakable-netherite-shovel)
